live_paired_replay.summary: Phase 24 closed on deterministic sample artifacts and a fixed-slice comparison harness. No stronger live paired env-first versus docker-first replay artifact has been frozen for verdict use yet.

current_recommendation_bias.summary: Docker-first has positive fixed-slice evidence on correctness and total runtime, but the current proof remains fixed-slice only and Phase 23 browser verification is still pending. The default closeout recommendation should therefore remain optional unless execution adds stronger live evidence or clears the remaining verification debt.
